title: For Republicans planning post-Trump future, one race in Washington is worth watching
summary: The primary to replace Rep. Dan Newhouse is a rare opportunity for Washington's Republicans to seek federal office. Candidates representing different wings of the party are testing Trump's influence.
contentText:
